name: Indicator Removal on Host
summary: Adversaries may attempt to remove indicators of their presence on a system in an effort to cover their tracks. In cases where an adversary may feel detection is imminent, they may try to overwrite, delete, or cover up changes they have made to the device.

strategies.name: Detection of Indicator Removal on Host

analytics.name: Analytic 1882
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an audit log clearing event or deletion/truncation of an Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor application log file, immediately preceded by other suspicious activity on the same host within a short lookback window. Documented in the CaddyWiper deployment alongside Industroyer2, explicitly intended to destroy evidence and slow forensic recovery. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics,…

analytics.name: Analytic 2113
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies truncation or deletion of Industrial Control System (ICS) application or auth log files, or modification of bash history, by a User Identifier (UID) that does not normally manage log rotation. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2192
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) network device syslog showing a gap in expected event sequence numbers, or syslog forwarding interruption from a device coinciding with a period of suspicious activity on that device. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2245
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) field device event logs being cleared via ICS protocol commands from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, occurring immediately following other suspicious ICS activity on the same device. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
